sector_news.headline: SPR, Sohna emerge as South Gurugram's next real estate growth engines as prices surge
sector_news.figure: SPR avg ~Rs 16,249/sq ft, up 18.4% YoY in 2026 (165% over 5 years, from ~Rs 9,800/sq ft); Sohna avg ~Rs 10,642/sq ft (up >140% over 5 years, from ~Rs 7,600/sq ft) -- data attributed to Magicbricks

sector_news.headline: Dwarka E-way area sees 135% rise in home prices in 5 years: Report
sector_news.figure: Dwarka Expressway avg residential price rose from Rs 6,032/sq ft (2021) to Rs 14,180/sq ft (H1 2026), vs Gurugram's overall average of Rs 13,350/sq ft -- data attributed to Anarock

sector_news.headline: Golf Course Extension Road property prices double in 5 years
sector_news.figure: GCER new-launch rate rose from ~Rs 8,800/sq ft (2019) to ~Rs 20,267/sq ft (2024); resale values up ~79% over same period, pushing many multistorey apartments above Rs 17,000/sq ft -- attributed to Savills India, Cushman & Wakefield, Square Yards, 99acres

sector_news.headline: Move over Bengaluru and Hyderabad: Noida and Gurugram top property price appreciation with up to 125% growth
sector_news.figure: NOTE: city-wide Gurugram figure, not Sector-74/corridor-specific (no Sector 74-specific article found). Gurugram avg residential price rose 117%, from Rs 6,150/sq ft (2019) to Rs 13,350/sq ft (Q2 2026) -- attributed to Anarock Research
